source_text: Subditus esto Domino et ora eum; noli aemulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua. Gloria Christo. Amen.
thought_title: Submit to the Lord and do not envy the prosperous
orientation: Origen is quoting the psalmist's command to submit to the Lord and pray, and not to envy the one who prospers in his way, then closing with a doxology to Christ.
pass_a_gloss: Be subject to the Lord and pray to him; do not envy the one who prospers in his way. Glory to Christ. Amen.

choices.why: The imperative of sum with the perfect passive participle subditus expresses the commanded state of submission; 'be subject' keeps the passive force and the command.
The verb oro takes an accusative of the person addressed; 'pray to him' makes the object explicit in English.
The glossary requires 'envy' for aemulari; noli with the infinitive is the standard negative command.

choices.term: in eo qui prosperatur in via sua
choices.english: the one who prospers in his way
choices.why: The relative clause identifies the person; 'prospers in his way' keeps the literal sense of prosperatur and via sua.
rejected: the one who has success in his path
him who thrives in his way

choices.why: The doxological formula uses the dative of the person glorified; 'Glory to Christ' is the standard English rendering.

bible_refs.note: Subditus esto Domino et ora eum; noli aemulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua

pass_b_english: Be subject to the Lord and pray to him; do not envy the one who prospers in his way (Psalm 37:7 (LXX 36:7)). Glory to Christ. Amen.

problems.source_quote: Subditus esto Domino et ora eum; noli aemulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua
problems.why: Wrong verse citation: this is Psalm 36:7 (LXX), not Psalm 37:7.
problems.ruling: Latin 'Subditus esto Domino...' matches Vulgate Psalm 36:7, not 37:7; citation misleads reader to wrong verse.

fixed: Wrong verse citation: source is Psalm 36:7 (LXX), not Psalm 37:7.

problems.source_quote: Subditus esto Domino et ora eum; noli aemulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua
problems.why: Verse is Psalm 36:7 in Hebrew numbering, not LXX 36:7; should be Psalm 37:7.
problems.ruling: Latin matches Vulgate Psalm 36:7 (LXX numbering), but 'Hebrew 37:7' label is wrong; Hebrew is 37:7, LXX is 36:7.

fixed: The source verse 'Subditus esto Domino et ora eum; noli aemulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua' is Psalm 37:7 in Hebrew numbering, so the citation should be Psalm 37:7 (LXX 36:7).

last_rejected.source_quote: Subditus esto Domino et ora eum; noli aemulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua
last_rejected.why: The citation should be Psalm 36:7 (LXX), which corresponds to modern Psalm 37:7, not Psalm 37:7 (LXX 36:7). The format reverses LXX and Hebrew numbers.
last_rejected.ruling: Format 'Psalm 37:7 (LXX 36:7)' correctly gives Hebrew number first, LXX in parentheses. Not reversed.
